translations.web: God opened her eyes, and she saw a well of water. She went, filled the container with water, and gave the boy a drink.
translations.bsb: Then God opened her eyes, and she saw a well of water. So she went and filled the skin with water and gave the boy a drink.
translations.kjv: And God opened her eyes, and she saw a well of water; and she went, and filled the bottle with water, and gave the lad drink.
translations.asv: And God opened her eyes, and she saw a well of water. And she went, and filled the bottle with water, and gave the lad drink.
